key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but BHP faces pressure as iron ore prices crumble
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property
Multiple gold/uranium discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Manhattan, Kaiser, Larvotto) boost junior mining sentiment
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, signalling structural shift in automotive/consumer sector
Qantas engine flame incident raises operational risk concerns for QAN.AX
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network (SVA.AX), reshaping media sector ownership
Consumer stress deepens: Australians driven into second jobs as mortgage costs bite; sentiment of feeling poorer persists
US stock market anomaly (3rd time in 100+ years) flags potential volatility ahead

sectors.trend: Mixed: large-cap miners under pressure from falling iron ore (BHP), but junior gold/uranium names rallying on multiple discoveries. Forrestania joins 2Moz club; Kaiser reloads gold inventory; Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M.
sectors.implications: Rotation from large-cap iron ore exposure to gold and uranium juniors. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds; GSG.AX, WES.AX (gold) and uranium names benefit. Diversification within materials is key.

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA's refusal to intervene create credit risk overhang for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. Mortgage stress and second-job trends signal rising NPL risk. Fixed vs refi rate differentials persist.
sectors.implications: Banks face margin compression and potential provision build. RBA inaction on property removes a key support. Monitor NIM trends and credit growth data closely.

sectors.trend: Energy stocks rallied within the ASX index. Tanker wars not expected to suppress oil prices. Graziers challenging energy zone development signals policy friction in renewables transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil resilience. Renewables developers face community/policy headwinds. LNG exposure (WDS.AX) remains a structural positive.

sectors.trend: BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point. Car supply crunch driving early write-offs and higher insurance premiums. Consumer stress with second jobs and feeling poorer.
sectors.implications: Traditional auto retailers (WOW.AX, WES.AX auto) face structural disruption. Insurance (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) sees premium upside. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network (SVA.AX). Baidu gains Shanghai/Shenzhen Stock Connect access, reshaping global AI equity flows. Oracle integrating HPE Juniper into AI data centres.
sectors.implications: SVA.AX ownership consolidation may stabilise governance. Global AI capex cycle continues. Limited direct ASX tech exposure but sentiment spillover positive.

sectors.trend: Qantas engine flame incident (QAN.AX) raises safety/operational scrutiny. Spirit of Tasmania operator in debt until 2052. Ash falls in Jakarta strand Australian travellers.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces near-term sentiment hit and potential regulatory review. Transport REITs and infrastructure names see mixed signals.

key_themes: Iron ore price weakness pressuring large-cap miners; gold/uranium juniors outperforming
Housing market deterioration with RBA inaction creating financial sector overhang
EV adoption tipping point in Australia disrupting traditional automotive and insurance models
Consumer financial stress: second jobs, mortgage burden, declining sentiment
Geopolitical risk: Trump threats, tanker wars, El Nino climate impact
US market structural anomaly (3rd in 100+ years) warning of potential volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / BHP earnings downgrade
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; rotate into gold and uranium juniors; hedge with commodity futures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA inaction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property REITs (VGP.AX, DGP.AX); monitor bank NPL data; avoid leveraged property positions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer credit stress and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour banks with stronger capital buffers (CBA.AX); avoid high-beta consumer discretionary names
Maintain defensive allocation; hold gold (GSG.AX) and energy (WDS.AX) as hedges
Monitor QAN.AX for regulatory response; short-term sentiment trade only

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US market structural anomaly / midterms volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce USD-linked exposure; maintain AUD-hedged positions; watch ^AORD for risk-off spillover

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore majors to gold and uranium juniors
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; multiple gold discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Larvotto) and uranium (Infini) signal sector tailwinds
Energy stocks rallying; tanker wars not suppressing oil; LNG structural demand intact
Housing stress raises NPL risk across sector, but CBA's capital position and diversified revenue offer relative safety

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and large-cap iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating housing falls with RBA inaction; iron ore price weakness pressuring BHP/RIO/FMG earnings

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain defensive allocation in healthcare and consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer stress and geopolitical risk favour defensive sectors; CSL.AX and WES.AX staples provide stability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and monitor El Nino commodity impact
defensive_moves.rationale: El Nino threatens agricultural output; Trump policy threats create FX volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near current levels. Energy and miner rally provides support, but housing stress and BHP iron ore weakness cap upside. Qantas incident and US market anomaly add near-term volatility. Expect range-bound trading on ^AXJO with sector rotation dominating.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore cycle, housing correction, and consumer stress suggest cautious 6-12 month outlook. Gold/uranium and energy offer relative outperformance. RBA's hands-off property stance may prolong adjustment. EV transition and AI capex provide selective growth pockets.
